aboutSection.title: Driving World-Class Intelligent Manufacturing
aboutSection.bodyHtml:
Guangdong TXAM Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in Shenzhen, a national technology hub. Over nearly two decades, we have adhered to our corporate philosophy of Dedication, Steady Development, Reputation First, Quality Supreme, focusing on non-standard automated production line design and manufacturing.

As a long-term partner of major enterprises including TCL, Skyworth, Midea, Konka, and Changhong, we have achieved integrated operations in R&D, production, sales, and service.

productsSection.title: Three Core Product Categories
productsSection.subtitle: From single flexible machines to complete factory automation, providing full-spectrum intelligent manufacturing solutions.

unitCard.title: Robot Single Machine Units
unitCard.summary: High-flexibility systems solving specific process bottlenecks. Such as: high-precision robot dispensing machine (±0.2mm), 180-degree flipping unit, and OC lamination units using UVW platform. Supports CAD import for one-key product changeover.
